column3: “Lifting up on you a lamentation” is rendered “take up for you as a dirge.”
“Abandoned” is rendered “lies neglected.”
NASB adds “strong” and “left.”
“And live” is rendered “that you may live.”
“Seek” is rendered “resort to,” and “go into exile” “go into captivity”; “trouble” renders a Hebrew word that also means “nothing.”
“And live” is rendered “that you may live,” and “rush” “break forth”; NASB supplies “O” before “house of Joseph.”
NASB adds “For” and continues the quotation from verse 6.
“Turns into the morning deep darkness” is rendered “changes deep darkness into morning”; NASB adds “also.”
“Causes to flash devastation” is rendered “flashes forth with destruction.”
“Speaks blameless” is rendered “speaks with integrity.”
“Trample” is rendered “impose heavy rent,” and “a portion of grain you take” “exact a tribute of grain”; NASB adds “Though … Yet.” The meaning of the first verb is uncertain.
“Opposers” is rendered “distress,” and “takers of ransom” “accept bribes.”
“At that time” is rendered “at such a time.”
“And may it be thus” is rendered “And thus may.”
“Set up” is rendered “establish,” and “show favor” “be gracious.”
“Open places” is rendered “plazas”; “those who know lamentation” is rendered “professional mourners.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Why this to you” is rendered “For what purpose will the day of the LORD be to you?”
“The house” is rendered “goes home”; NASB adds “Or.”
“And not light” is rendered “instead of light.”
“Feasts” is rendered “festivals,” and “assemblies” “solemn assemblies.”
“Pay attention to” is rendered “even look at.”
“Music” is rendered “sound,” and “lyres” “harps.”
“Wadi” is rendered “stream.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“You will lift up” is rendered “You also carried along”; NASB keeps the names “Sikkuth” and “Kiyyun.”
NASB renders “whose name is the God of hosts” as the end of the verse; “send into exile” is rendered “make you go into exile.”
